prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished raster UI concept for RuneNexus mobile game, portrait 880x1800 approx 22:45 aspect. Input image 1 is the CURRENT UI style and surrounding screen reference. Preserve the reference background, underlying tower-module screen, bottom navigation, dark scrim, and existing blue-gray beveled chamfered metal modal frame with small centered diamond crest, matte navy interior, cool silver edging, cyan restrained details. Change ONLY the draw-results modal interior and the modal's height needed for readable content. This is a realistic implementable mobile game interface, front-on flat screenshot, no phone/device surround. Modal width about 92% of screen. Typography: crisp Korean sans serif, white title, legible pale blue body; dark fantasy sci-fi rune metal, no web dashboard appearance, no excessive ornament/glow or nested frames. Header exact text "모듈 뽑기", small upper-right "×", subtitle exact "모듈 5개를 획득했습니다." Bottom ONLY one full-width metal outlined button exact "닫기", no retry, no equip, no additional new feature controls.
Represent EXACTLY FIVE obtained MODULES, not five turrets. Each module has a clearly distinct pictogram matching its part: core = square microchip with inner core and pins; barrel = paired gun tubes; frame = mechanical round brace with crossed supports. Icons read as refined dimensional metal module parts/glyphs (core cyan chip, barrel gunmetal tubes, frame silver brace), avoiding whole tower thumbnails. Grade color accents only: rare warm muted gold, magic blue, normal gray. SAME five sample items across all variants, following order, EXACT text:
1) "희귀 · 과열 연산 코어" and "피해 +12% · 공격속도 +6%"
2) "마법 · 경량 총열" and "공격속도 +8%"
3) "일반 · 안정 프레임" and "설치 비용 −4%"
4) "일반 · 과열 연산 코어" and "사거리 +5%"
5) "마법 · 안정 프레임" and "치명타 확률 +3%p".
Use concise names/effects, absolutely accurate Hangul, omit no items and repeat no item. Icons and texts must be visibly paired; five modules total. Preserve surrounding screen proportions and darkened view as reference. Do not include proposal labels A/B/C inside the app.
LAYOUT A — five compact horizontal rows. Modal tall enough to contain header, five evenly spaced rows, and footer button without crowding. Each row has one approximately 52dp icon on left with a restrained dark socket, to its right two readable lines: grade + module name above and effect summary below. Use thin separators, shared modal background, no individual row card boxes. Rarity accents can be a narrow line beside each icon and grade text. Every effect summary directly beside its icon. Simple balanced rows, generous enough line height, modest spacing. Modal centered about screen midpoint.
